segments.text: okay so the thing I keep coming back to is pricing
like I know the backend costs about twenty cents an hour
but I don't know if people will pay seven dollars
I guess what I'm really asking is whether the free tier is too generous
three sessions a month is a lot if each one costs me money
but if it's less than that nobody gets hooked
and the comparables are all more expensive so maybe I'm underpricing anyway
no wait that's a different question
the question is what the free tier is for
it's for feeling the thing three times
so the cap should be on the expensive part not on sessions
listening is cheap, prompts cost money, notes cost money
which means free sessions can run long as long as the prompts stop
twenty minutes of prompts feels right
yeah I think that's the decision, cap the prompts not the sessions
